question: 'Ranapa', a folk dance form of Odisha, consists of enacting from the life of Lord ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Krishna.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The 'Ranappa' dance is from the state of Odisha dedicated to Lord Krishna.**
 
• **Odissi, Danda Nata, Chhau, and Ghumaru are the other popular dance forms.**
 
• **Capital:** Bhubaneswar.
 
• **Chief Minister:** Mohan Charan Majhi
 
• **Governor**: Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati
 
• **Official Language**: Odia.
